metadata.defaultTitle: Tello Printing Center — Professional Printing Equipment
metadata.description: Tello Printing Center is a retail store and supplier of professional printing equipment, including 3D, DTF and UV printers, printing materials, inks, parts and accessories.

hero.title: Your trusted supplier for professional printing equipment.
hero.description: Tello Printing Center is a retail store and supplier of professional printing equipment, materials and accessories. Browse machines, compare product options and order the equipment your business needs.
hero.imageAlt: Professional printing equipment displayed for customers

about.title: A retail supplier focused on printing equipment.
about.description: Tello Printing Center is a retail store and supplier of professional printing equipment. We bring together printers, materials, consumables and accessories in one catalog so customers can compare product options and buy with confidence.
about.imageAlt: Professional printing equipment and materials displayed for customers
about.body: Our catalog covers 3D printers, filaments and materials, DTF and UV equipment, industrial printing machines, inks and consumables, and printer parts and accessories. Our team helps customers understand product options and choose equipment that suits their work.

points.precisionDescription: Printers and production equipment organized into clear product categories.

points.supportDescription: Product information and ordering support to help customers choose suitable equipment.
